paper.title: Sleep stage classification from heart-rate variability using long short-term memory neural networks
paper.claim: The paper classifies four sleep-stage groups for each thirty-second epoch using sequences of 132 HRV features and a three-layer LSTM.
paper.population: SIESTA cohort of 292 participants and 584 PSG nights, including healthy participants and people with sleep apnea, insomnia, Parkinson's disease, or periodic limb movement disorder.
paper.referenceStandard: Sleep stage scored from overnight PSG by two trained somnologists, with a third expert resolving disagreement.
paper.relationEvidence: The CC-BY paper publishes the method but no code or fitted model. The supplied unlicensed MATLAB repository is not linked by the paper, uses a different six-stage ontology, and calls itself a simple framework.

sources.name: CC-BY paper method in Europe PMC XML

compatibility.brainstemContract: not-defined: proposed full-night HRV and PSG sleep-stage contract
requiredSignals: continuous artifact-screened full-night beat-to-beat intervals sufficient for all 132 paper features
participant-separated PSG sleep-stage labels from trained scorers
compatibility.window: Thirty-second epochs represented by centered beat-to-beat windows, usually 4.5 minutes and up to 510 seconds for specific entropy features.
compatibility.preprocessing: Withheld until an independent implementation and data freeze beat detection, artifact handling, every feature parameter, centering, normalization, stage mapping, participant split, fitted model, calibration, and uncertainty.
mismatches: The current Brainstem contract has not been proven to reproduce all 132 paper features over continuous full-night coverage.
Brainstem records do not carry independently scored PSG sleep-stage labels.
The paper's fitted model and SIESTA training data are not freely available.
The supplied repository is unlicensed, uses a different stage ontology, and is not implementation provenance for the paper.
No Brainstem device, age, or sleep-condition calibration against PSG has been completed.

cohort.output: Withheld until public participant-level reproduction and protected Brainstem-versus-PSG calibration pass review.

personal.output: Withheld; no sleep-stage label, sleep score, condition inference, chart, or free-text proxy may be returned from this candidate.

prohibitedClaims: negative or healthy interpretation of abstention
